## Step 10: Build the Phyloseq object

```{r load-phyloseq}
library(phyloseq)
library(Biostrings)
library(ggplot2)
theme_set(theme_bw())

seqtab.nochim <- readRDS(file.path(rds_dir, "seqtab_nochim.rds"))
taxa <- readRDS(file.path(rds_dir, "taxa.rds"))
```

```{r build-metadata}
samples.out <- rownames(seqtab.nochim)

# group/gender = leading letters; subjects = digits before "D"
gender_code <- sub("^(A-Za-z]+).*$", "\\1", samples.out)
subject <- sub("^[A-Za-z]+([0-9]+)D.*$", "\\1", samples.out)
day <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(sub("^.*D([0-9]+)$", "\\1", samples.out)))

samdf <- data.frame(
  Sample = samples.out,
  Gender = ifelse(gender_code == "F", "Female",
                  ifelse(gender_code == "M", "Male", gender_code)),
  Subject = subject,
  Day = day,
  row.names = samples.out,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Early vs Late
samdf$When <- ifelse(samdf$Day < 100, "Early", "Late")

# Mock/Control samples will not fit longitudinal design
is_ctrl <- grepl("mock|control|blank|ntc", samples.out, ignore.case = TRUE) | is.na(samdf$Day)
samdf$When[is_ctrl] <- NA
samdf$Subject[is_ctrl] <- NA

head(samdf)
table(samdf$When, useNA = "ifany")
```

## Construct the object

```{r build-phyloseq}
ps <- phyloseq(
  otu_table(seqtab.nochim, taxa_are_rows = FALSE),
  sample_data(samdf),
  tax_table(taxa)
)

# replace long ASV sequences with short labels; keep sequences in refseq()
dna <- Biostrings::DNAStringSet(taxa_names(ps))
names(dna) <- taxa_names(ps)
ps <- merge_phyloseq(ps, dna)
taxa_names(ps) <- paste0("ASV", seq(ntaxa(ps)))

ps
saveRDS(ps, file.path(rds_dir, "phyloseq.rds"))
```

## Alpha Diversity

```{r alpha-diversity, fig.wdth=9}
# plot_richness expects raw counts (do not rarefy/transform first)
plot_richness(ps, x = "Day", measures = c("Shannon", "Simpson"), color = "When")
```

## Ordination (NMDS, Bray-Curtis)

```{r ordination}
ps.prop <- transform_sample_counts(ps, function(x) x / sum(x))
ord.nmds.bray <- ordinate(ps.prop, method = "NMDS", distance = "bray")
plot_ordination(ps.prop, ord.nmds.bray, color = "When", title = "NMDS (Bray-Curtis)")
```

## Abundance barplot (abundant families only)

```{r abundance-barplot, fig.width=11}
abundant <- taxa_names(ps)[taxa_sums(ps) > 500]
ps.ab <- transform_sample_counts(prune_taxa(abundant, ps), function(x) x / sum(x))
plot_bar(ps.ab, x = "Sample", fill = "Family") + facet_wrap(~When, scales = "free_x")
```
